name: JCATS (Joint Conflict and Tactical Simulation)
description: Entity-level constructive combat simulation developed at Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory modeling brigade-and-below land, sea, and air operations. Thousands of autonomous agent interactions produce emergent battlefield outcomes. Used by U.S. DoD, NATO, and more than 30 countries for training, analysis, and mission rehearsal.
general_score_metric: Scenario-specific outcome metrics (e.g., mission success rate, objective completion, casualty/attrition rates)
reputation: widely used by U.S. DoD, NATO, and 30+ allied nations for professional military training and operational analysis
notes: Entity-level resolution; models individual combatant and platform behaviors. Supports both constructive and virtual simulation modes. Interoperable with other DoD simulation systems via HLA/DIS protocols.
